### Item 4 — scored parameters
**(a) `processing_fee` (sign_pre_occupancy_cancellation_25852637)**
- Computation document (cancellation_processing_fee_calculation): "the plan's pre-occupancy cancellation processing fee percentage of the entrance fee of the agreement, rounded to the cent half up"; plan figure "Pre-occupancy cancellation processing fee percentage | 2 percent of the entrance fee" (rescission_and_cancellation_terms_by_plan).
- Fall-back (no factor): 406300.00 × 2% = **8126.00**.
- Factor "days of notice" (processing_fee_rate_by_days_of_notice): "60 or more days of notice take 1.0 percent". Notice date (notice_date_of_a_cancellation): "where a cancellation request on the agreement was registered by Larkspur and still awaits the resident's signature, the notice date is the day that request was registered" → 2026-09-02 (record above; the paired reservation was also closed 2026-09-02). Days to planned occupancy 2026-11-04 = 63 → tier ≥60 → 1.0%. Found from: the request record (pending pre-occupancy cancellation) and the agreement's planned occupancy date.
- Factor "extension surcharge" (occupancy_extension_surcharge): "where a signed occupancy extension is on file and the days of notice are 30 or more, the surcharge is 0.25 percentage points"; "The percentage and the surcharge are first added together ... applied once to the entrance fee ... this is the gross processing fee". Records: request `occupancy_extension`, `request_status 'signed'`; `occupancy_extensions_used 1`; 63 days → +0.25 → 1.25%. Gross = 406300.00 × 1.25% = 5078.75.
- Factor "trial-stay credit" (trial_stay_credit_on_cancellation): "3 to 6 nights a share of 0.5 ... the credit is that share of the trial-stay nightly charges posted in the same 12 months, rounded to the cent half up, and it is subtracted from the gross processing fee". Records: respite ledger `respite_nightly_charge 725.0`, `tier_billed 'Independent Living Trial Stay'`, `nights 5`, posted 2026-04-20 (within 12 months of the 2026-10-02 cancellation). Credit 362.50 → 4716.25. Found from: the customer's Respite and Short-Term Stay records (trial stay at Willow Creek).
- Factor "current renter" (cancellation_fee_for_current_renters): "where the customer holds an active independent living residency whose move-in date is 24 or more whole months before the cancellation, the fee after the trial-stay credit is halved and rounded down to the whole dollar". Records: IL residency Juniper Point `status 'active'`, `move_in_date '2024-03-11'`; to 2026-10-02 = 30 whole months → halved, down: 2358.125 → **2358.00**. Found from: the customer's active Independent Living Residency Agreement.
- **processing_fee = 2358.00.**

**(b) `refund_amount` (pay_pre_occupancy_refund_45806fa1)**
- Computation document (pre_occupancy_refund_amount): "the money received on the agreement ... less the processing fee entered on its ledger ... rounded half up". Fall-back reading only that document with the fee above: 40630.00 − 2358.00 = 38272.00; pure fall-back (fee also at baseline): 40630.00 − 8126.00 = **32504.00**.
- Factor "escrow rate" (escrow_rate_by_deposit_size): "a deposit of 40000.00 or more earns 2.05 percent a year"; deposit total 40630.00 → 2.05%.
- Factor "term bonus" (escrow_term_bonus): "60 to 89 days add 0.20 percentage points"; held 2026-07-08 → cancellation date (= termination date set by the signature, "Cancelled, with the signing day as its termination date") 2026-10-02 = 86 days → +0.20 → combined 2.25%.
- Factor "funds availability" (deposit_funds_availability): "a deposit paid by personal check accrues from 5 days after it was posted" → 86 − 5 = 81 accrual days. Record: `payment_method 'check'`, `'Check 2291'`; caller's opening: "paid a deposit by personal check".
- Factor "escrow day count" (escrow_interest_day_count_by_campus): "at Larkspur at Willow Creek the interest is the deposit times the combined rate times the accrual days divided by 360 ... rounded to the cent half up"; "the refund ... is the money received less the processing fee retained plus that escrow interest". 40630.00 × 2.25% × 81/360 = 205.689375 → 205.69.
- **refund_amount = 40630.00 − 2358.00 + 205.69 = 38477.69.**

### Item 6 — problem tree from the visible materials alone
- **P_root: pay the refund on a resident's own pre-occupancy cancellation.** Visible prerequisite sentence (pre_occupancy_refund_payment, "Release condition"): "A refund on a resident's own cancellation before occupancy is not paid until the agreement stands in cancelled status and its ledger carries the processing fee retained on that cancellation." Records: `status 'reserved'`; entrance ledger holds only the deposit row (no processing fee entry) → state does not hold.
- **Hop P_root ← P1 (resident's pre-occupancy cancellation signature): state-derived.** Searching the state words ("cancelled", "processing fee", "cancellation before occupancy") reaches pre_occupancy_cancellation_signature, whose effects table says "Agreement status | Cancelled ..." and "Agreement ledger | One processing fee entry for the amount retained"; the records show a `pre_occupancy_cancellation` request `pending_signature`. Combined: the waited-on state is brought about only by the customer signing that request through `sign_pre_occupancy_cancellation_25852637`. The refund document names no other tool and no route; the depended-on document does not mention the refund's wait.
- P1 has no visible prerequisite sentence of its own (its doc states eligibility only: rescission period ended, reserved status, signer authority — all hold).
- Order: P1 (user write) → P_root (agent write). Two problems; the root is the agent's write, the depended-on one is the customer's own write.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Closest alternatives excluded by visible sentences/records: (i) rescission at 100% — excluded by the 7-day Willow Creek period; (ii) notice date = day of signing (2026-10-02 → 33 days → 1.5% + 0.25) — excluded by "still awaits the resident's signature, the notice date is the day that request was registered" and the request row created 2026-09-02; (iii) caller's verbal "early September" call as the notice date — the document reads the record, and the record agrees (2026-09-02); (iv) certified-check accrual (86 days → 218.39) — the record says `check` / "Check 2291" and the caller says "personal check"; the KB's instrument table has "Personal check" and "Certified check" but no row for a bare `check` value, so the mapping rests on the caller's statement plus the record's plain value (residual reading risk, recorded); (v) fee percentage applied to money received (40630.00) instead of the entrance fee — excluded by "The percentage acts on the entrance fee of the agreement, not on the money actually received so far"; (vi) renter factor 0.75 tier — excluded by 30 whole months; (vii) ignoring the trial stay (charge posted 2026-04-20 for nights in May) — it is within 12 months and billed as "Independent Living Trial Stay".
- "Do only the one thing asked" (pay the refund straight away): excluded by the release-condition sentence and records `status 'reserved'`, no processing fee entry; "Any status other than cancelled | Any | No". The pre-solving check: the refund document does not name the signing tool, any route or chain; the hop is reached through the state words.
- Fall-back calculation: computable and definite (8126.00 fee; 32504.00 refund), differs from 2358.00 / 38477.69.
- Factor findability: each factor was reached through the record kind it reads — the request record and planned occupancy date (days of notice, notice date), the signed `occupancy_extension` request (surcharge), the Independent Living Trial Stay ledger row (trial-stay credit), the active Juniper Point Independent Living Residency (renter halving), the deposit ledger row's amount/method/posting date and the campus (escrow rate, funds availability, term bonus, day count). No computation document told me a variation exists.
- Dependency-form observations made while reading (to be judged in Step 3b after reveal): several factor documents name other factors' quantities — cancellation_fee_for_current_renters ("the fee after the trial-stay credit"), escrow_interest_day_count_by_campus ("the deposit's annual escrow rate with any term bonus added"; "Use in the refund ... plus that escrow interest"), escrow_term_bonus ("added to the escrow rate"), trial_stay_credit_on_cancellation ("The gross processing fee is the processing fee figured on the entrance fee"). Whether the source pins these orders inside the method tiers is a reveal-phase question.
